title: Automatic meta refresh navigation was not isolated in registry resources

examples: document.createElement('meta') followed by httpEquiv='refresh' assignment or mutation
reproduction.beforeFix: The gate returned pass for automatic redirects in JSX, React factories, and DOM-created meta elements.
reproduction.afterFix: The source gate rejects a known or unresolved refresh directive across JSX, React factories, direct DOM assignments, setAttribute, Object.assign, and property descriptor mutations.

rootCause: URL inspection covered navigation and resource attributes but did not classify meta httpEquiv refresh, an automatic navigation directive outside those attribute sets.
remediation: Reject static or unresolved meta refresh declarations across declarative, React factory, and DOM mutation forms; registry resources must not trigger automatic navigation.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "automatic meta refresh navigation"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: JSX and React factory redirects passed before the fix; probes also passed for direct DOM property and setAttribute forms
validation.canonicalResourceIsolationMatrix: 324 resources passed, zero warnings, zero failures

runtimeBoundary: Static parsing only; no meta element was mounted and no redirect occurred. Release-candidate browser verification remains pending.
